column1: # Namespaces of the langspan crate, read by scripts/ratchets.py (docs/development-process.md#ratchets).
#   namespace NAME LAYER         a top-level module of src/; LAYER is utility, infrastructure,
#                                application, interface, or - while it has none yet
#   allow FROM TO                a same-layer edge that isn't debt
#   only TARGET IMPORTER...      the only namespaces that may name TARGET
#   role NAMESPACE::FILE ROLE    src/NAMESPACE/FILE.rs is its own node: adapter or feature
# An edge that breaks these rows, or a cycle, needs an `edge` row in its module's baseline.
# Today's top-level modules carry the layer of the namespace they move into. The edges that
# layering exposes and the target layout forbids are debt rows in their modules' baselines:
# auto_check, definitions, integrate, landing, report, test_output, today, install and store
# -> hook, store -> wait, and graph -> definitions and reformat. Each allow row below is an
# edge inside one target namespace, or one the target layout allows (regions -> ids,
# shell -> fs, ipc -> fs, cli -> mcp and so on).
# Not yet, for the same reason: `only store daemon` (dashboard, main, mcp and status_line
# name store) and `only hook cli main` (13 modules name hook).
